Title: Show of force printed - always good or proxy?

Messages.Author: acbishop
Messages.Body:
Show of force has been published as part of the pdf expansions and also as a physical card in V5.

Tournament rules state that any printed card from pdf extensions are considered legal cards to play.

Do we need to print show of force with the Dance Macabre logo to be considered legal in a tournament?

If we print a show of force with the V5 logo, is it still considered legal to play or is it considered a proxy?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> acbishop wrote:
> If we print a show of force with the V5 logo, is it still considered legal to play or is it considered a proxy?
>
A proxy.
Only the PDF version is considered a PDF card rather than a proxy.
